messages:
mia: Heads-up — AcmePay just pushed a customer request: private pilot on Dedicated with HSM/KMS + tight latency expectation (they asked for ~99ms p50). They want a go/no-go in 72h. Need alignment on scope, minimal launch guardrails, and owners across runtime/infra/platform/security. Who can join a quick sync?

tariq: I can join. Quick notes: p50 ~99ms is doable but only if we use prefix/KV cache + prewarm + a quantized 8-bit variant. Otherwise p50 will be ~200ms. Also need to know model size & max seq.

jules: Infra: we have cold capacity but provisioning a dedicated GPU pool for a single tenant normally takes 3 days. We can expedite to ~48h if we reassign two infra engineers and accept limited observability retention.

sasha: Security: HSM integration path exists but KMS policy review + creds rotation + basic pen test waiver for pilot usually 5 days. We can do an emergency skim review in 48h if the scope is limited (no external logs, no customer-managed keys until later).
olivia: Platform: can wire a customer routing policy and canary flag. But routing-by-customer + dedicated model pin needs a tiny API change (adds a route param) and a migration in Console. Estimate 1 dev day.

kevin: AcmePay is fine with constrained throughput for pilot (they proposed 50 rps) and are ok with explicit fallback to hosted if latency degrades. They want clear launch criteria though.

mia: Proposed minimal launch guardrails (draft) — please react and edit:```
- Throughput cap: 50 rps
- Latency target: p50 <= 150ms (target), must be <= 250ms or auto-fallback to hosted model
- HSM: KMS-only for keys, no key rotation during pilot
- Observability: token-level cost + latency traces enabled, logs not forwarded off-prem
- Security: emergency skim review in 48h, full review post-pilot
- Rollout: canary for first 24h, then ramp to customer cap
```

tariq: +1 but change p50 target to 120ms or we won’t be able to consistently hit it for long prompts. Also add: model variant = quant-8 / KV-cache on; max seq len 1024.

jules: +1 to infra expedite, but infra owner needed: assigning Jules as infra lead — I can take the reassign if product ok. I need 2 engineers, a ticket to reorder capacity, and approval to lower observability retention to 7 days for this pool.
sasha: I'll take security lead for the 48h skim. Need a minimal docs package from product: threat model (1 page), data flow diagram, and list of admin IPs.
olivia: Platform will own the routing change. I can slot a dev tomorrow AM. Need API schema + test vector.

mia: Ok owners draft: tariq (runtime lead), jules (infra lead), sasha (security lead), olivia (platform lead), kevin (sales/SE liaison). I'll assemble the 1-pager and test vectors. Action items:
- mia: produce 1-pager + example payloads (ETA: 3h)
- tariq: validate quant-8 perf + KV cache plan and share perf numbers (ETA: 12h)
- jules: start capacity expedite request and confirm engineer names (ETA: 6h)
- sasha: kickoff skim review checklist and list required docs (ETA: 4h)
- olivia: PR for routing param (ETA: 24h)

deploy-bot: Canary gating configured when staging config is pushed. Runbook: `canary -> monitor 1h -> ramp`.

kevin: AcmePay confirmed they will pause any external integrations during pilot and accept the fallbacks. Will get contract addendum signed.

mia: Sync set for 16:30 today, 15m stand. If anyone can't make it, post updates here. Let's try to get the 1-pager up first. :thumbsup:
